title: Taxonomy of multi-agent design patterns, anti-patterns, and lessons from manufacturing
summary: Multi-agent coordination is a distributed systems problem, not a model problem. This post gives a field-tested taxonomy of multi-agent design patterns and anti-patterns, a framework for deciding when multiple agents are warranted, and how to build cost-efficient, reliable systems
reason: Blog post offering a conceptual taxonomy of multi-agent design patterns and anti-patterns. It is architecture guidance/commentary, not a model release, research artifact, business event, policy action, or open-source tool/framework release, so no active rule covers it.
